Overview

Maiduguri is a city in Borno with a population of 1,197,000. The capital of Borno State in northeastern Nigeria, known for its strategic location on the Sahel trade routes. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
